description.narrative: The Project has an AIMM rating of Good based on an AIMM score of 53. On an unadjusted basis (i.e., without likelihood factor), the full potential AIMM score could reach 64. The most significant expected project-level outcome is the increase in access to finance for SMEs operating in Cote dIvoire. This Project is part of a program of interventions that IFC has been pursuing with several FIs in Côte dIvoire with the intention of providing SME risk-sharing facilities to promote greater market competitiveness through demonstration and replication effect.

The proposed project is an unfunded Risk Sharing Facility (RSF) for a portfolio of credit facilities of up to XOF25 billion (c.US$41.4 million) originated by NSIA Côte dIvoire, where IFCs exposure is up to 50 percent of the maximum portfolio. The purpose of this facility is to support the Banks financing of Very Small and Medium Enterprises (VSEs and SMEs) in Côte d'Ivoire.
